origin: Original synthetic GUI scenarios authored for codex-toolbox; no private interface, user data, or measured result is represented.

conditions.A: Current Codex computer use with ordinary observations and action calls.
conditions.B: Codex computer use with compact observations and safe action-plus-observation batching, without Jev.
conditions.C: Condition B with selective Jev action recommendations; Codex verifies and executes every action.

families.objective: In the browser, open the {section} section and then the {target} record.
families.observation: Navigation currently shows the {section} button and other section buttons. No record row is visible yet.

families.objective: In the browser, search for {target} and open its result.
families.observation: Search field is empty; record results are not visible until a search is submitted.

families.objective: In the browser, filter to {status} and open {target}.
families.observation: Status options are open: All, Ready, Active, Review, and Hold. The {target} row was visible in the All view with status {status}.

families.objective: In the browser, choose the {tab} tab and open {target}.
families.observation: Four tab buttons are visible: Pending, Archive, Current, Later. The currently selected tab shows non-target {decoy}.

families.objective: In the browser, expand group {group} and open {target}.
families.observation: Expand buttons for group {group} and three other groups are visible. The {target} row appears after expanding its group.

families.objective: In the browser, use the Open control in the {target} row, where {decoy} has an identical Open label.
families.observation: Four row-scoped Open controls are visible in the Quartz, Cedar, Nimbus, and Orchid rows; {target} is the target.

families.objective: In the browser, reorder the list and then open {target} using its current row, not {decoy}'s former position.
families.observation: A Reorder list control changes row positions; indexes from before reorder cannot identify {target} afterward.

families.objective: In the browser, refresh state to reveal missing {target}, then open it rather than {decoy}.
families.observation: The {target} record is absent from the current view; Refresh state can reveal it. {decoy} is visible.

families.objective: In the browser, search for {target}, retry after the first No results state, then open it.
families.observation: The search field is visible. A first search for {target} later produces No results and a Retry search control.

families.objective: In the browser, open the picker dialog and choose {target}, not {decoy}.
families.observation: The picker dialog is open with row-scoped Open buttons for Quartz, Cedar, Nimbus, and Orchid, plus Close picker. {target} is the target.

families.objective: In the native app, open the {section} section and then the {target} record.
families.observation: Horizontal section buttons include {section} and three other sections. No record row is visible yet.

families.objective: In the native app, search for {target} and open its result.
families.observation: Native search field is empty; record results are not yet visible.

families.objective: In the native app, filter to {status} and open {target}.
families.observation: Status picker options are open: All, Ready, Active, Review, and Hold. The {target} row was visible in the All view with status {status}.

families.objective: In the native app, choose the {tab} tab and open {target}.
families.observation: Horizontal tab buttons include Pending, Archive, Current, and Later; non-target {decoy} is currently visible.

families.objective: In the native app, expand group {group} and open {target}.
families.observation: Expand buttons for group {group} and three other groups are visible. The {target} row appears after expansion.

families.objective: In the native app, use Open in the {target} row, where {decoy} also has Open.
families.observation: Four identically labeled Open buttons are scoped to the Quartz, Cedar, Nimbus, and Orchid rows; {target} is the target.

families.objective: In the native app, reorder the list and then open {target} from its current row, not {decoy}'s old position.
families.observation: Reorder list changes accessibility element positions; a prior index cannot identify {target} afterward.

families.objective: In the native app, refresh state to reveal missing {target}, then open it rather than {decoy}.
families.observation: The current native list omits {target}; Refresh state can reveal it. {decoy} is visible.

families.objective: In the native app, search for {target}, retry after the first No results state, then open it.
families.observation: Native search field is visible. Searching for {target} later shows transient No results with Retry search.

families.objective: In the native app, open the picker dialog and choose {target}, not {decoy}.
families.observation: The native picker sheet is open with row-scoped Open buttons for Quartz, Cedar, Nimbus, and Orchid, plus Close picker. {target} is the target.
